projection: p_c=R*p_m+t; r=K*p_c; reference_xy=(r0/r2,r1/r2). Canonical box signs times [400,600,72]mm. Camera in model coordinates=solve(R,-t); exact supplied R/K/t retained.
native_order: Exact existing V74 normal_facing_permutation pure AST, perm[dynamic]=canonical. No q-dependent permutation or GT-best matching.

original96_grid.continuous_crop_index_xy: t=96*(reference_xy-original_q_xy)/original_L+47.5; original q maps to(47.5,47.5), between the central4 samples.
original96_grid.inside_outer_crop_extent: -0.5<=tx<95.5 AND -0.5<=ty<95.5; equivalently q-L/2<=reference<q+L/2, half-open. This describes the continuous crop pixel cells, not an exact sampled center.
original96_grid.inside_sample_center_rectangle: 0<=tx<=95 AND 0<=ty<=95; inclusive bounding rectangle of96x96 sample centers.
original96_grid.reference_has_original_sampler_valid_dom: -0.5<=reference_x<W-0.5 AND -0.5<=reference_y<H-0.5, separately from original continuous-valid q.
original96_grid.not_validity_gate: These three booleans are nominal geometry diagnostics only. They never change original_query_available/inputU, q/L, crop pixels, native labels or admission.

nominal_discrepancy.authority: Nominal discrepancy only, not physical coordinate error/gold or a quality target. No cutoff or fitted threshold.

missing: Invalid/missing/nonfinite/sentinel q or nonpositive/nonfinite L => footprint/discrepancy null with reason, original rows/flags retained. Nonpositive reference camera-Z => diagnostic invalid/UNKNOWN, no visible/self/external inference.
association: Lookup only the C unique-positive-max-bbox-IoU weak association when selected_obj_id==1 and exact original GT-list index exists. All other outcomes UNKNOWN, no fallbackinstance.
